page_title: FIO 1-0 LAZ | Fiorentina v Lazio 13/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Michael Fabbri is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' That didn't go as planned! Pedro (Lazio) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past David de Gea, who easily kept it out.
90+6' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) receives a reproachful look from his teammates after he attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a shot from long distance. The ball flew far wide of the right post.
90+4' Pedro (Lazio) violates the laws of the game and is shown a yellow card by the referee, but it could have been a straight red as well.
90+4' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
90+4' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+2' Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
90+1' A yellow card for bad language! Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
90+1' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90+1' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) launches a cross from the corner, but David de Gea is alert to thwart the effort.
89' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
85' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) is penalised for a foul. Michael Fabbri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
84' Substitution. Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jacopo Fazzini walks off.
81' Petar Ratkov (Lazio) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
80' This is a yellow card! Dodo (Fiorentina) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
80' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Robin Gosens is replaced by Luis Balbo (Fiorentina).
79' Substitution. Kenneth Taylor did his best and is replaced by Petar Ratkov (Lazio).
79' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.

76' Gustav Isaksen sends a lovely lofted pass forward that flies over the top of the defence and into the path of Tijjani Noslin (Lazio), but he can't direct his header on target as it flies well wide of the left post.
76' Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
74' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!

73' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Michael Fabbri with no other option than to blow for a foul. Lazio have a free kick from a promising distance.
71' It is time for a substitution. Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) is on for Daniele Rugani.
67' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Pedro (Lazio) replaces Boulaye Dia.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Cancellieri trots off the pitch and is replaced by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
67' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
64' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) receives a yellow card.
63' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Lazio, he's going to review using VAR.
60' Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
60' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
59' Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
58' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the right side of the goal, but Edoardo Motta keeps it out with an amazing save.
57' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
54' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

54' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lazio are going to take it.
52' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
51' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
50' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

47' Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Edoardo Motta!
46' Maurizio Sarri makes a switch. Tijjani Noslin is coming on in place of Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) at the start of the second period.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Toma Basic comes off for Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but David de Gea easily deals with the threat.
43' The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
43' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
40' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
36' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
35' Lazio are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
32' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
31' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Daniele Rugani (Fiorentina) for his blatant foul.

28' 1 - 0 Jack Harrison displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross deep into the box. Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) gets on the end of it and heads it inside the right post, via a deflection off the post. 1:0.
25' Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Toma Basic (Lazio) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
22' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) makes a rough challenge and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Lazio.
21' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
19' Dodo (Fiorentina) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
14' The foul by Toma Basic (Lazio) was seen by Michael Fabbri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
13' Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Edoardo Motta intercepts the ball.
12' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
10' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
10' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but David de Gea pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
9' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Edoardo Motta, who smothers the ball.
5' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina).
4' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
4' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lazio.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.

3' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the right side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from David de Gea, who tips the ball around the post.
2' Good movement by Kenneth Taylor (Lazio), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Lazio will take the kick-off.
Michael Fabbri will supervise the game today.
